externalResourceEligibility: PENDING: the supervisor's global resource receipts before GO and after TIMED_WINDOW_END decide resource eligibility; no internal resource pass is assumed

gpuElapsedCoverage.off: runner's existing per-call command-buffer elapsed total (gpuEndTime - gpuStartTime) over its synchronous command buffers; OFF commits no async router overlap tickets; not busy time, utilization or gain; never compared with ON
gpuElapsedCoverage.on: INCOMPLETE: synchronous command buffers only; EXCLUDES the asynchronously committed router overlap R/S ticket command buffers (2 per layer per forward), so coverage differs from OFF and reference; async ticket intervals are not reported and must not be added (a sum is not busy time); not busy time, utilization or gain; never compared with OFF
gpuElapsedCoverage.reference: direct serial Gemma4Runner.forward gpuMicros for the call; no router overlap tickets exist on this path; different execution path and coverage from OFF/ON; not busy time, utilization or gain; never compared between arms

identity.modelSha256Source: ModelDigestCache cached record (cached-explicit-refresh); never hashed, re-verified or refreshed by this tool

notes: Diagnostic only: no artifact, no winner, no activation, no promotion; gainQualified is always false and a numerical or performance result is not resource eligibility.

Both arms share one executable, one runner, the installed v1 E4R32 routed lowering (installMoeBaselineForVerification, hard-pinned recorded source SHA), Q4 reference width 32 and the declared full modern candidate (par64 parallel attention on); only the router overlap preparation and scope differ. CPU FP64 routing is unchanged.

Counter expectations follow actual source accounting per forward: v1 GU = ACT = DN = ceil(topK / 4) * layers, ordered merges = topK * layers, router scale and resident zero = layers, statistics compute = plan groups (= layers) and reuse = plan reuses (= 2 * layers), cooperative RMS = unplanned RMSNorm instructions, cooperative Q6 = Q6 matvecs, parallel attention = attention ops, router launch applied = router projections (= layers, declared divisor 1; 0 in the direct reference); ON overlap applied = layers, async commits = drained = 2 * layers, pending 0; every fallback 0.

Dispatch multiset proxy: per-name kernel attribution does not exist in segment-batched mode, so equivalence is established by the exact per-family counters plus total kernels ON == OFF and command buffers ON == OFF + layers per forward, checked for prefill (prompt forwards) and each continuation separately.

The existing reusable-statistics inverse buffer is pre-sized once before any dispatch (allocation only) so its lazy first growth cannot flush an open segment inside the first OFF token and perturb buffer totals.

Command-buffer elapsed (gpuEndTime - gpuStartTime) is recorded per call with arm-dependent coverage (gpuElapsedCoverage): ON values exclude the asynchronously committed router overlap R/S ticket command buffers, are incomplete and do not share coverage with OFF or the reference. No arm's value is busy time, utilization or gain; values are never compared between arms, and the separate async ticket intervals are neither reported nor added (a sum would not reconstruct busy time).

Wall timers bracket only executeGraph(prompt) and each executeGraphContinue(previous argmax), including the normal CPU argmax and logits readback; candidate calls include the runtime's unavoidable per-token overlap guards. Scope entry, install/source/binding checks, counter snapshots and finiteness/ID checks run outside the timers.
The supervisor's raw-line and state disk journaling of the stdout progress lines adds nonzero observation overhead between timed calls.
Model SHA-256 is the cached explicit-refresh record; this tool never hashes, re-verifies or refreshes the model file.

protocolSpec.normalization: per output: max_i |logit_i - reference_i| / max(1, max_i |reference_i|), strictly < 1e-4 against the same fresh direct reference
protocolSpec.outlierPolicy: none: every raw latency is reported and used; no retry, rescue, adaptive stop or exclusion
protocolSpec.statistic: run TPOT = median of its 31 continuation walls; arm TPOT = median of its 7 run TPOTs; spread = (max - min) / median per arm per fixture; gain = (baseline - candidate) / baseline per fixture
